free_tier.stated: Free: 5 build credits a day, capped at 30 a month, so the cap is spent in the first 6 days of each calendar month; Pro starts at USD 25 a month for 100 credits, plus 5 daily build credits with no monthly cap
free_tier.notes: a credit is not a fixed unit of work: each message is charged on the work done, so the 30 free credits buy a variable number of messages

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the plan meters credits, not stored bytes

retention.stated: not applicable: no stored bytes are metered

egress.terms: not published on the pages read: no egress term was found, so nothing is asserted

interface_detail: a web app where a prompt builds a project. Git sync with GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket is on every plan. The Lovable REST API at api.lovable.dev/v1 (Lovable-API-Key header, keys start lov_) manages and deploys existing projects, needs a Business or higher plan, and spends no build credits. AI project creation and editing run through the Lovable MCP server, which is open to every plan and spends the same credits as the web app
tooling: hosted service with a web editor; no local client is documented. An MCP client such as Claude or Cursor can drive project creation and messages through the MCP server on any plan
chaining: Pro, USD 25 a month for 100 credits (USD 250 a year), adds code editing and download, custom domains and credit rollover; the Lovable API needs Business, whose 100-credit tier is USD 50 a month. Plan mode costs 1 credit a message; Build mode messages are priced by the work done, from 0.50 credits for a one-line style change to 1.70 for a landing page with 3 generated images. Chat messages usually cost a fraction of a credit and draw first on a separate daily chat allowance of unpublished size

limits.value: Free: 5 build credits a day, 30 a month; the monthly cap is reached on the sixth day and daily credits resume on the 1st at 00:00 UTC
the Lovable REST API and workspace API keys need a Business or Enterprise plan; Free and Pro workspaces see an upgrade prompt

limits_note: the 30-credit Free cap binds first; the API gate is a plan gate, and the API itself spends no build credits
binding_note: 30 build credits a month on Free, spent in the first 6 days of the month

identity_cost.detail: sign-up offers email, Google, GitHub or Apple and opens a Free personal workspace; the sign-up page shows an account form with an Email option and no card or phone field. Paid plans are billed through Stripe; what checkout asks for is unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: the chat allowance and the monthly Cloud and AI grants are stated as temporary offers subject to change; the chat pricing is stated to apply through 2026-10-31, a date that had passed on the day read, and whether it was extended is unverified
confidence_note: plan table, credit rules, API and MCP terms are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-02; the size of the daily chat allowance is not published, and the checkout requirements of Pro were not seen
